title: SessionGapLogEntry
description: A single router-observed gap, failure, retry, or warning during a pipeline session. Written by the router to .claude/context/runtime/session-gap-log.jsonl (one entry per line).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the router observed this gap

taskId.description: Task ID associated with the gap, if applicable

agent.description: Agent type that exhibited the gap behavior

description.description: Human-readable description of what the router observed

context.description: Additional context such as file paths, error messages, or gap lists

source.description: Who created this entry: router (default), agent via TaskUpdate metadata, or a hook
